zh.text:
再考虑物点位于主光轴上的情况。
这时，三条方便的特殊光线合并为主光轴上的同一条光线，不能据此确定一个交点。
图 180 因而另外选择光线 $SB$，其中 $B$ 是光线到达透镜的位置。
先过光心作平行于 $SB$ 的副光轴 $PQ$，再在透镜的出射光一侧作通过像方焦点 $F$、垂直于主光轴的焦平面，求出它与副光轴的交点 $C$。
在近轴模型中，折射光线 $BC$ 通过 $C$；把它与沿主光轴的光线一起使用，就得到了两条光路。
图中光源 $S$ 位于焦点和会聚透镜之间，折射光线发散，向后的延长线确定虚像点 $S_1$。
向后的延长线是作图线，不代表光沿该方向实际传播。
zh.source_text: 我们再研究一种情况：即需要作出位于主光轴上点的像.这时困难在于所有这三条方便的光线都合并成一条与主光轴重合的光线. 所以需要确定射至透镜上的任一点$B$的光线$SB$的光路(图 180). 为作出折射线我们作平行于光线$SB$的副光轴$PQ$，然后作焦平面$F$，求出焦平面与副光轴的交点$C$. 折射线$BC$就通过$C$点. 这样一来，就作出了$S$点发出的两条光线的光路. 经透镜折射后，这两条光线发散. 因为光源位于焦点和透镜之间，所以点$S$的像$S_1$是虚像.

en.text:
Now consider an object point on the principal axis.
The three convenient special rays then coincide with the principal axis and do not by themselves determine an intersection point.
Figure 180 therefore selects another ray $SB$, where $B$ is its point of arrival at the lens.
Draw the secondary optical axis $PQ$ through the optical center, parallel to $SB$; on the outgoing-light side of the lens, draw the focal plane through the image-side focus $F$, perpendicular to the principal axis, and let its intersection with the secondary axis be $C$.
In the paraxial model, the refracted ray $BC$ passes through $C$; together with the axial ray, this gives two light paths.
The source $S$ shown lies between the focus and the converging lens, so the refracted rays diverge and their backward extensions locate the virtual image point $S_1$.
Backward extensions are construction lines, not paths along which the light actually propagates.
en.source_text: 我们再研究一种情况：即需要作出位于主光轴上点的像.这时困难在于所有这三条方便的光线都合并成一条与主光轴重合的光线. 所以需要确定射至透镜上的任一点$B$的光线$SB$的光路(图 180). 为作出折射线我们作平行于光线$SB$的副光轴$PQ$，然后作焦平面$F$，求出焦平面与副光轴的交点$C$. 折射线$BC$就通过$C$点. 这样一来，就作出了$S$点发出的两条光线的光路. 经透镜折射后，这两条光线发散. 因为光源位于焦点和透镜之间，所以点$S$的像$S_1$是虚像.

changed_phrase.text: 先过光心作平行于 $SB$ 的副光轴 $PQ$，再在透镜的出射光一侧作通过像方焦点 $F$、垂直于主光轴的焦平面，求出它与副光轴的交点 $C$。

Draw the secondary optical axis $PQ$ through the optical center, parallel to $SB$; on the outgoing-light side of the lens, draw the focal plane through the image-side focus $F$, perpendicular to the principal axis, and let its intersection with the secondary axis be $C$.

SCI.judgment: Both locales now expressly select the outgoing-light/image-side focal plane through F, not the object-side focus. This resolves the sole frozen H01 uncertainty.
SCI.physics: In the stated paraxial converging-lens construction, the optical-center secondary axis is parallel to incident SB. Its intersection C with the image-side transverse focal plane gives the direction point for refracted BC. The axial ray is the second path. An object between the incident-side focus and lens gives divergent emerging rays; their backward construction extensions locate virtual S_1 rather than representing actual backward light propagation.
SCI.full_context: L1-L2 retain the axial point and three coincident special rays; L3 retains SB and B at the lens; L4 retains PQ through the optical center parallel to SB, F defining a perpendicular plane, and the plane-axis intersection C; L5 retains paraxial BC and the axial second ray; L6-L7 retain inside-focus divergence, virtual S_1, and the backward-extension warning. The changed L4 does not negate or redirect those steps.

ZHEN.judgment: The changed Chinese outgoing-light side and image-side focus qualifications correspond to the English outgoing-light side and image-side focus. Both preserve PQ, SB, F, C, perpendicularity, intersection order and the plane-versus-point distinction; F is not renamed or moved in any source/figure object.
ZHEN.full_context: The seven lines correspond in axial degeneracy, arbitrary SB/B ray, PQ/plane/C construction, paraxial BC plus axial ray, inside-focus virtual S_1, and the no-backward-propagation warning. Only R08 and its changed phrase were semantically judged in this batch.
